snippet.title: Reader Rabbit's Interactive Reading Journey Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
Reader Rabbit's Interactive Reading Journey Full Playthrough

Reader Rabbit's Interactive Reading Journey is a game created by The Learning Company in 1994. It was re-released as Reader Rabbit Reading Adventures Ages 4-6 in 1998. The sequel to this game, Reader Rabbit's Interactive Reading Journey 2, was released in 1996.

Playthrough of the Updated Version:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_UboUTZdclk
